recognize_zh: 綠色對比染色背景中，一個卵圓形生發中心內的細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，邊界清楚，外圍外套區與濾泡間區則為陰性；中心內散在的白色空洞為巨噬細胞，符合正常生發中心標記（如 CD10）的染色樣式。
features: Sharply circumscribed oval follicle center with brown membranous staining of most cells
Stronger staining toward one pole of the germinal center
Scattered unstained clear spaces within the center (tingible body macrophages)
Negative surrounding mantle and interfollicular zones with green counterstain
Specific antigen not identified in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a green counterstain shows a sharply circumscribed oval germinal center in which most cells show brown membranous staining, somewhat stronger toward one pole, while the surrounding mantle and interfollicular zones are negative. Unstained clear spaces within the center correspond to tingible body macrophages. The antigen is not specified; the pattern is typical of a germinal center B-cell marker such as CD10. Findings are consistent with a normal reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: In FL, CD10 highlights crowded neoplastic follicles and often also interfollicular neoplastic cells, and the follicles lack tingible body macrophages and polarization.
FDC markers show a dendritic lacy network rather than crisp membranous staining of individual lymphoid cells.
